# Remote Control Agent v0.1.51 — macOS failed-upgrade recovery hardening

This reviewed five-platform Agent candidate addresses the first failed real Mac
v0.1.50 detached-upgrade incident without changing the existing device ID,
pairing protocol, cloud grant, SQLite receipts or other platform installers.

## Changes

- macOS: wait for the old per-user LaunchAgent's removal from launchd before
  registering its replacement, including safe rollback, so a delayed bootout
  cannot race the new LaunchAgent (PR #115).
- macOS: replace restart-prone `launchctl submit` with an owner-private
  `launchctl bootstrap` plist that sets `LaunchOnlyOnce`, preventing a
  failed detached upgrade from being automatically restarted (PR #116).
- macOS: add a strictly explicit, export-only, dry-run-by-default historical
  failed-transaction reconciliation function. It verifies exact original
  identity, generation, live LaunchAgent, immutable failure records, file
  hashes and an absent failed job. Only a separately approved call may archive
  the two exact historical admission markers after recording verified audit
  evidence. It never alters the old failure result or permits replay (PR #117).
- Retain Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows x64 behavior and the existing reviewed
  immutable Agent Release, manual Worker pin and signed WSS acceptance process.

## Evidence and safety boundaries

- Reviewed source: `03a14fd4138ca8d77fa8aced78f7a53ccc51724e`
  (merged PRs #115, #116 and #117).
- Native source CI: [main #41487926467](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41487926467),
  final attempt 2, five platforms passed; first Windows run had an isolated
  temporary-file cleanup lock and failed-only retry passed.
- The separate five-platform immutable v0.1.51 candidate must pass
  [Actions #41490186540](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41490186540)
  before any protected Release. Checksums and assets must match its
  exact-head, retained GitHub Actions artifacts.
- Publishing this Agent does **not** update the existing RCA Worker installer
  pin or upgrade any paired Mac. Explicit protected Worker publication,
  exact owner-Mac failed-record reconciliation and any later remote upgrade
  each require their own authorization and independent real-device acceptance.
- Historical failed v0.1.50 operation
  `097c1008-5498-4a1d-ae70-b7eff25253cd` remains permanently non-retryable.
  Its original `needs_attention` result, old receipts and audit logs are
  preserved. A new operation, only after safe reconciliation, needs a
  separately approved forward version. Do not automatically re-pair.
- Developer ID signing/notarization, Gatekeeper approval and previously waived
  physical-host scenarios are not implied by CI success.

Related: [Issue #660](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/660).
